decisions.rationale: The slash-joined string names two separate diseases, adrenoleukodystrophy and adrenomyeloneuropathy, so it is one contiguous composite mention.
Adrenoleukodystrophy is a single well-defined disease with no further categorization.
ALD is the abbreviation of adrenoleukodystrophy and is annotated as its own separate mention.
X-linked inherited metabolic disorder describes a family of multiple specific diseases rather than one specific definition.
